rubric.role_summary: Product designer with 5+ years of experience, independently taking product design projects from concept through UX and interface execution. The role involves collaborating with engineers and other teams on a collaborative workspace product.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Product designer with 5+ years of experience, independently taking product design projects from concept through UX and interface execution. The role involves collaborating with engineers and other teams on a collaborative workspace product.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of working experience.
- Experience creating human interfaces.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience designing and building tools with small teams.
- Ability to code as a designer.
- 5+ years of working experience and well-rounded skills and experience to run projects independently end to end.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California; New York metropolitan area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.

must_haves.source_quote: You have well-rounded skills and experience to run projects independently end to end. 5+ years of working experience.
You create clear, intuitive, and visually appealing human interfaces.

preferences.requirement: Ability to code as a designer.
preferences.source_quote: You are a designer who can code!

preferences.requirement: 5+ years of working experience and well-rounded skills and experience to run projects independently end to end.

location.requirement_text: Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
source_quotes: This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

soft_requirements: Seeks to understand customer needs and advocates for strong user experiences.
Comfortable untangling vague conceptual problems; has intuition for accessible mental models and flows.
Creates clear, intuitive, visually appealing interfaces and balances craft, speed, and business needs.
Listens and collaborates well with stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
Uses words and visuals to tell stories and drive alignment.
Intellectually curious and excited to use AI as a collaborator.
Interest in resolving fragmented tools and information silos; familiarity with influential computing thinkers and complementary perspectives are described as nice-to-haves.
